case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We welcome your proposal for a 24-month contract, as it provides valuable planning security for both our companies. However, your target prices do not allow us to cover the rising wage costs we previously outlined. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

In recognition of the longer term, we are prepared to revise our offer to a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. It is always a pleasure working with your team, and we look forward to continuing our long standing partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are willing to accommodate your request to delay the effective date to 1 April 2027 to support your planning. This represents a significant concession on our part, and we hope you recognize our commitment to our long-standing partnership.

For our Angebot, we present a price of €50.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 April 2027. This offer stays valid for 30 days. message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We appreciate your continued movement towards a mutually viable agreement. In response to your revised offer, we are prepared to make a further concession to a price of €50.40 per unit for the contract term of 24 months with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

This step reflects our commitment to our long-standing partnership, but please understand that we are reaching the limits of what is feasible given our cost structure. For generations, our foundry has valued the deep ties with our partners in the region, and we take pride in delivering the utmost quality for your operations. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
